## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [求那跋陀羅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B1%82%E9%82%A3%E8%B7%8B%E9%99%80%E7%BE%85) Guṇabhadra is the famous *Bá yī qiè yè zhàng* dhāraṇī — the *Pure Land Spirit-Spell* — one of the most widely-recited dhāraṇīs in Chinese Pure Land devotional practice. The dhāraṇī is recited as a prelude to *niàn fó* practice and is believed to remove the karmic obstacles that would otherwise impede rebirth in *Sukhāvatī*.
